name: design-harness-agent
description: Run a product-neutral, taste-aware design pipeline from evidence and alternatives through approved implementation and QA.

interface.shortDescription: Taste-aware product design, implementation, and QA.
interface.longDescription: Resolve brand and product context, learn from scoped design memory, generate distinct product-native directions, wait for exact approval, then implement and report QA evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use the connected Design Harness to explore three product-native design directions before implementation.
